critique: The render closely matches the Classic Fractal look: dense blue particle-line fields on black, sweeping fractal-like ribbons, crisp bright convergence points, and a clearly animated evolving structure between t1 and t4. The remaining mismatch is tonal: several ribbon intersections and edge contours blow out to near-white, reducing the layered cool-blue depth and making parts of the particle lattice look flatter than the preset's richer blue separation.

suggestions.why: Lower maximum particle opacity so dense overlaps retain blue tonal detail instead of clipping into white contour bands.
